Definition: a Charuphite or inhabitant of Charuph (or Chariph)
BiblicalUsage: A Haruphite is an inhabitant of Haruph, and the word appears once, among the mighty men who came to David at Ziklag: Shephatiah the Haruphite.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the roll call at Ziklag names towns for a reason: Shephatiah's home is part of his standing.
